steps.note: Trigger function that copies customer_id into customer_id_new on every insert (and on any update of customer_id).
steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION orders_sync_customer_id_new() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$ BEGIN NEW.customer_id_new := NEW.customer_id; RETURN NEW; END $f$;

steps.note: Add a nullable bigint column customer_id_new (metadata only, no table rewrite) and the sync trigger in one transaction, so every row inserted from now on has it filled. Short lock_timeout with retries, so the app's queries never queue behind this for long.
steps.sql: DO $$ DECLARE tries int := 0; BEGIN LOOP BEGIN PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout', '200ms', true); ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN customer_id_new bigint; CREATE TRIGGER orders_sync_customer_id_new BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF customer_id ON orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION orders_sync_customer_id_new(); EXIT; EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN tries := tries + 1; IF tries >= 300 THEN RAISE; END IF; PERFORM pg_sleep(0.1); END; END LOOP; END $$;

steps.note: Backfill the rest: orders the app inserted before the trigger existed (ids above 10000000). Later inserts are filled by the trigger.
steps.sql: UPDATE orders SET customer_id_new = customer_id WHERE id > 10000000 AND customer_id_new IS NULL;

steps.note: Add CHECK (customer_id_new IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID: a brief lock and no scan; enforced for new rows from now on. Retries on a short lock_timeout.
steps.sql: DO $$ DECLARE tries int := 0; BEGIN LOOP BEGIN PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout', '200ms', true); ALTER TABLE orders ADD CONSTRAINT orders_customer_id_new_not_null CHECK (customer_id_new IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID; EXIT; EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN tries := tries + 1; IF tries >= 300 THEN RAISE; END IF; PERFORM pg_sleep(0.1); END; END LOOP; END $$;

steps.note: Validate the check: a full scan under SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE, which does not block the app's reads or inserts. Fails, and stops the plan, if any row was missed.
steps.sql: ALTER TABLE orders VALIDATE CONSTRAINT orders_customer_id_new_not_null;

steps.note: Verify every row has customer_id_new = customer_id before the swap; raises, and stops the plan, on any mismatch.
steps.sql: DO $$ DECLARE bad bigint; BEGIN SELECT count(*) INTO bad FROM orders WHERE customer_id_new IS DISTINCT FROM customer_id; IF bad > 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '% rows have customer_id_new <> customer_id', bad; END IF; END $$;

steps.note: Swap in one short transaction: SET NOT NULL (no scan; the validated check proves it), drop the trigger, drop the old integer column, rename customer_id_new to customer_id, drop the now-redundant check. All metadata only, so the exclusive lock is held for milliseconds. The app keeps using the name customer_id, so no deploy is needed. Retries on a short lock_timeout.
steps.sql: DO $$ DECLARE tries int := 0; BEGIN LOOP BEGIN PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout', '200ms', true); LOCK TABLE orders IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE; ALTER TABLE orders ALTER COLUMN customer_id_new SET NOT NULL; DROP TRIGGER orders_sync_customer_id_new ON orders; ALTER TABLE orders DROP COLUMN customer_id; ALTER TABLE orders RENAME COLUMN customer_id_new TO customer_id; ALTER TABLE orders DROP CONSTRAINT orders_customer_id_new_not_null; EXIT; EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN tries := tries + 1; IF tries >= 300 THEN RAISE; END IF; PERFORM pg_sleep(0.1); END; END LOOP; END $$;

steps.note: Drop the sync trigger function, no longer used.
steps.sql: DROP FUNCTION orders_sync_customer_id_new();

steps.note: Check the result: orders.customer_id is bigint NOT NULL; raises otherwise.
steps.sql: DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid = 'orders'::regclass AND attname = 'customer_id' AND atttypid = 'bigint'::regtype AND attnotnull AND NOT attisdropped) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'orders.customer_id is not bigint NOT NULL'; END IF; END $$;

steps.note: Reclaim the dead row versions left by the backfill and refresh statistics (does not block reads or writes).
steps.sql: VACUUM (ANALYZE) orders;
